_comment: 3s Elemental. Both pools rode MIP's FFF feed (E = Energy, G =
Consistency) until MIP was removed mud-side on 2026-09-15. They now
come off GMCP, wire-confirmed against logs/gmcp_20260922_204710.log
Consistency (gp2, a percentage, so gp2max is the constant 100).
GMCP carries no Energy MAXIMUM, so gp1max is parsed off the prompt's
ZERO kills you, which is why it carries warn thresholds - the only
guild pool in the repo that is lethal at the bottom.
Note hp/sp maxima are NOT ceilings here: 'evoke corpse drain' takes
sp over max (747 against a real max of 526), so the bars can read
past full. That is the truth, not a scaling bug - see

aliases.tt: evoke create blast;activate blast;give blast to %*

triggers.pattern: seems to be most susceptible to (.+) attacks\.
triggers.command: evoke resolve as \1;evoke prismatic emission as \1
triggers._note: Both of the elemental's damage-type settings follow the mob's susceptibility - Guild.Extra carries them as resolve_type and prismatic_emission. ';' is the command separator, same as the tt alias.

triggers.pattern: You reach out and touch (.+) with a shimmering hand

vitals.label: Consistency
vitals._note: GAME FACT: consistency does no harm until it reaches ZERO, which kills you - so these are set for AWARENESS, not for a damage threshold. Amber at 70% is deliberately early. Note diffuse CAPS consistency at 50%, so a permanently amber bar while diffused is expected, not a fault.
